title: Mission 90 Days
desc: The prime minister of the nation gets killed and an efficient police officer, Sivaraman, gets appointed by the government to solve the murder mystery. He gets ninety days to accomplish the mission.

title: Kaliyil Alpam Karyam
desc: Vinayan, a wealthy city-bred guy, moves to a village to lead a simple life. In a turn of events, he falls in love with a girl who wants the exact opposite.

title: Parampara
desc: When a gang of criminals kidnaps Johnny's son, he is left with no choice but to work with Lawrence, his estranged father, to save him.

title: Kuttettan
desc: Although married, Vishnu is a habitual flirt and always looks out for an affair. When he is almost caught with a young girl in his house, he lies to his family that she is his illegitimate daughter.

title: Kerala State Lottery Result
desc: The host reveals the ticket numbers and announces the names of the people from the state of Kerala who have won the lottery.

title: Koushalam
desc: Gopinadhan and Mathunni steal money from the rich and distribute it amongst the needy. When Mathunni robs Maya, Gopinadhan returns it and falls in love with her.

title: Bandhukkal Sathrukkal
desc: Two brothers, both moneylenders, hate each other and extend their mutual hatred to their families as well. However, they face several obstacles that intensify after their estrangement.
